differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Chronic NSAID use and poor nutrition in a low‑SES pregnant patient likely cause iron loss despite normal ferritin (acute‑phase elevation possible).

differential.name: Folate deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Low socioeconomic status, limited diet, and increased folate demand in pregnancy can produce macrocytic anemia with elevated RDW.

differential.name: Drug‑induced bone marrow suppression (e.g., opioid/alcohol)
differential.rationale: Dependent drug abuse can depress hematopoiesis, leading to anemia and thrombocytopenia with otherwise normal labs.

differential.name: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP)
differential.rationale: Critical low platelet MPV and count suggest an immune‑mediated platelet destruction, especially in a young adult.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic pain, migraine, and possible low‑grade inflammation can cause normocytic anemia with normal ferritin.
